author: EpicAlios
name: LoadingSpinner
shortDescription: A collection of animated spinners, loaders and loading indicators (rings, arcs, dots, pulses, bars, text effects...) to show a loading state in your game.
description: Give your players a loading state! This extension provides a curated collection of animated spinners, loaders and loading indicators, inspired by [Loading UI](https://www.loading-ui.com/) (free and open source).
All animations are drawn procedurally with PixiJS inside a custom object, so they stay sharp at any size and need no image resources.
- **Rings**: ring, spokes, classic, dots ring, spiral, swirling, concentric ring, orbit ring, satellite ring, clock ring, quarter ring, dash ring, comet spinner.
- **Dots**: dots, bobbing dots, bouncing dots, typing, twin orbit, pulsating dots, triple dot spinner.
- **Text**: text shimmer, text blink, text dots, text shimmer wave.
- **Shapes**: infinity, morphing infinity, diamond, wave, bars, square grid, square snake, skeleton, terminal...
Each loader can be customized (color, size, thickness, speed) and controlled with actions and conditions (start, stop, pause, change style).
Useful for loading screens, waiting for network responses, saving indicators, "thinking" states for NPCs, etc.
